calls.title: MC <> Growthbook
calls.summary: The team explored the implementation of Growthbook’s platform for physical retail stores, identifying use cases such as point of sale systems, self-checkout, employee task management, and customer kiosks. Key recommendations included cluster-based A/B testing to avoid data skewing and the necessity of accessing MC's centralized data warehouse for effective experiment analysis. Technical challenges regarding offline device operations and data synchronization were raised, prompting a proposal for a follow-up discussion with Growthbook’s head of experimentation. Additionally, the user licensing model was clarified, accommodating approximately 50 accounts under Pro and Enterprise plans, while emphasizing the flexibility of data retention and export options. Next steps include preparing detailed questions for the upcoming technical call to refine the pilot scope.
calls.keywords: POC, physical store experimentation, A/B testing, feature flagging, centralized data, user roles

**NEVES Ricardo Jorge**
